title: Titanium Coilover Spring
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is selected for Titanium Coilover Spring where unsprung mass reduction directly improves suspension response and lap times. The 45% density reduction vs steel (4.43 vs 7.85 g/cm³) at equivalent strength enables rod and link components to meet fatigue targets >10^6 cycles under dynamic racing loads. Elastic energy storage per unit mass (σ²/2Eρ = 18.5 kJ/kg) is 2.3× that of 4130 steel — optimal for High-performance racing coil suspension spring (Beta-C). This rationale is driven by high-performance racing coil suspension spring (beta-c) and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for suspension geometry
Shot peening Almen with SPC sampling
Black oxide/DLC coating with SPC sampling
CMM SPC dimensional check with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for highperformance racing coil application
commonFailures: Fatigue crack at thread-shank transition - prevented by larger fillet R0.5->1.5mm + cold rolling — critical for highperformance racing coil performance

faq.q: What weight-to-strength ratio does Titanium Coilover Spring offer over steel?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130/4340 steel at equivalent strength: 4.43 g/cm³ vs 7.85 g/cm³ with 830 MPa yield. For highperformance racing coil, this translates directly to reduced unsprung mass (suspension) or reduced reciprocating mass (valvetrain), improving both acceleration response and fatigue-limited component life by 2-3×.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Coilover Spring orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Coilover Spring is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Coilover Spring?
faq.a: Each Titanium Coilover Spring shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for highperformance racing coil.
